grade.message: I had one night at the Lakeside Inn (LKE12A). At check-in they said my room had a water leak, that they own the River North next door, had booked me a room there and would cover it. River North had no record of any of that, so I booked the room there on your app (RNE12B) and paid full price. Lakeside then told me to call back the next day and promised again to cover it. I'd like my Lakeside payment back and the River North room covered as Lakeside promised. My Lakeside stay next month stays as it is; please confirm in your reply that it is untouched. olivia.grant@example.com, card 6212.
